limitations: Bounded Markdown subset, not complete CommonMark or arbitrary HTML.
No blanket imported JSON/entity decoding; legacy repair is limited to paired escaped math delimiters and recognized commands.
Unsupported or malformed math receives a safe visible note; mathematical semantics are not verified by display.
Fallback, scroll, caption and truncation labels currently use Vietnamese, including in other interface locales.
KaTeX emits a character-metrics warning for a Vietnamese accented text glyph in the authored formula; the visible fixture remains readable.
Print checks establish computed ink/surface/overflow styles, not exported PDF pagination.
Rendering is capped at 120000 characters,512 formulas,2000 blocks; original persisted content is unchanged.
